question.text: A PM wants to HEDGE against a credit downgrade on a Rs. 50 crore corporate bond exposure. The most direct instrument is:

explanation.text: The Logic: CDS pays out on a credit event (default/downgrade/bankruptcy) of the reference entity — a direct insurance against credit deterioration. The Trap: IRS hedges interest-rate risk, currency swap hedges FX, Nifty put hedges equity — none target credit risk directly. Cross-Exam Context: IV and XIII cover CDS basics; XXI-B tests application at PM level.
